description: Build inputs of zeb/potoru 0.1. The Potoru packages (@potoru/player, @potoru/authoring) are not published to npm yet, so the bundle is built from a Potoru source checkout: set POTORU_SRC to its designer/e3 folder (dependencies installed there with npm ci) and run `node build/build.mjs` from the hand-off folder. esbuild is taken from POTORU_SRC/node_modules.

dependencies.@potoru/authoring: 0.1.0 (from POTORU_SRC/authoring/src and app/src/format, not on npm yet)
